blocks.x: Sense, simulate, act — the operations stack for physical assets.

BI & Analytics Platform bridges sensor fabric to decisions: governed telemetry (OPC UA/Sparkplug) from retrofit-friendly devices, physics+data digital twins with validated models, edge inference fleets with OTA, predictive maintenance wired into CMMS work orders, and the scenario engines planners actually use.

Twinverse is built for brownfield reality: non-invasive mounting, protocol translation from fieldbuses, offline-first edge patterns, and calibration discipline. Twins ship with the decisions they must improve and the baseline they must beat — a decision instrument, not a 3D screenshot.

Twinverse runs IEC 62443-aligned segmentation for industrial estates, hardware roots of trust and signed boot on edge fleets, and privacy governance (face blurring, retention) for camera systems. Telemetry carries contracts — units, timestamps and lineage are trustworthy by construction.

items: every artifact the platform produces doubles as audit evidence — no reconstruction projects.
teams start at pattern 80% and spend their budget on the 20% that is genuinely yours.
named control owner per deployment; platform telemetry makes the owner's job inspectable.

blocks.x: BI & Analytics Platform typically enters an estate during the Prove phase — configured for your controls in the sandbox, hardened through Industrialize, and left running under the customer's own keys with our pods on the follow-the-sun operations rhythm.
Certified integration surface: OPC UA, MQTT Sparkplug B, LoRaWAN/NB-IoT, KubeEdge/K3s, CMMS/MES adapters.
Primary industry deployments: Manufacturing & Industrial, Energy & Utilities, Logistics & Supply Chain, Retail & Consumer Goods, Agriculture & Food Systems, Healthcare & Life Sciences.
